metaDescription: Shiga Tafiyar Uwa, shirin gwajin kula da uwa a jihar Gombe.

login.headline: Kula da uwa a Gombe
login.intro: Gwada shirin cibiyoyin lafiya na Gombe a matsayin uwa, ma’aikacin lafiya, likitan asibiti ko mai gudanarwa.
login.staffDescription: Zaɓi sunan asusunka na gwaji ko ka rubuta shi, sannan ka shigar da PIN mai lambobi huɗu.
login.motherDescription: Yi amfani da lambar shaidar uwa da lambar PIN ɗinki da kika samu a cibiyar lafiya.
login.maternalIdHint: MC- sai haruffa da lambobi guda shida.
login.demoGuideDescription: Tambayi mai gudanar da gwajin lambar PIN ɗin asusunka.

simulator.title: Gwajin wayar salula mai sauƙi
simulator.intro: Gwada yadda za a duba ranar alƙawari ta wayar salula mai sauƙi.
simulator.simulationHint: Wannan gwajin yana aiki a burauza. Za a ƙara USSD da aika SMS a mataki na gaba.
simulator.signIn: Shigar da lambar shaidar uwa da PIN
simulator.loginHint: Yi amfani da lambar shaidar uwa da PIN ɗin da kike amfani da su a shafin alƙawarinki.
simulator.visitTip: Zuwa awo a kai a kai yana taimaka wa ma’aikacin lafiya ya gano matsala da wuri. Kafin ki bar asibiti, ki tambayi ranar da za ki dawo.
simulator.visitSource: Shawarar WHO game da zuwa awo
simulator.foodTip: Ki yi ƙoƙarin cin abinci iri-iri da ake samu a yankinku, kamar wake, kayan lambu masu ganye da ’ya’yan itatuwa. Idan kin je awo, ki tambayi irin abincin da ya dace da ke kuma za ki iya saya.
simulator.foodSource: Shawarar WHO game da abinci ga mai juna biyu
simulator.tipReview: Ki tattauna wannan bayanin da ma’aikacin lafiya.
simulator.motherOnly: Ki fita daga asusun ma’aikaci don gwada tsarin da lambar shaidar uwa da PIN ɗinta.
